Bouchey Financial Group LTD Trimmed Apple (AAPL) Position as Share Value Rose; As Nxp Semiconductors (NXPI) Shares Rose, Lvm Capital Management LTD Has Decreased Its Stake by $3.04 Million 
March 22, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson 
Bouchey Financial Group Ltd decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.72% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bouchey Financial Group Ltd sold 2,189 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 78,261 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $12.06 million, down from 80,450 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bouchey Financial Group Ltd who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $867.15 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.22% or $0.37   $170.9. About 30.43M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Lvm Capital Management Ltd decreased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors (NXPI) by 40.25% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 39,875 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $4.51 million, down from 66,735 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lvm Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $41.71B market cap company.
